verdict.rationale: Claude publishes llms.txt files at support.claude.com (confirmed by an HTTP 200 probe) and at platform.claude.com. The platform llms.txt documents agent-oriented surfaces: an MCP docs server, JSON SDK-version metadata, and .md mirrors of every docs page including the API reference. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and the support-center root .md path probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://support.claude.com/llms.txt # Claude Help Center
Connect an MCP client to https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp (Streamable HTTP transport) to search and read these docs
